record: National Register Hotel Ponce de Leon nomination and Casa Monica architectural history
facts: Franklin Smith built Casa Monica using a smoother poured concrete mix than his earlier work on Ponce de Leon. Both opened in January 1888. Casa Monica's Spanish and Moorish motifs set it apart.

record: St. Augustine Town Plan Historic District nomination
facts: The Casa Monica, then called Cordova Hotel and later used as a county courthouse, was the largest Moorish Revival structure in St. Augustine.
The guidelines identify the hotel at 95 Cordova Street as a Moorish Revival example. Towers, cast-concrete crenellations, horseshoe openings, and wood and metal balconies are characteristic.
